Quaternius Buildings Pack source record

Creator: Quaternius
Official source: https://quaternius.com/packs/buildings.html
Exact license: CC0 1.0 Universal
License URL: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Acquisition date: 2026-08-28
Attribution requirement: None. Creator credit is retained for provenance.

The retained SOURCE_PAGE.html is an offline snapshot of the official pack page.
It identifies the creator and links the pack to the CC0 1.0 Universal deed.
PREVIEW_1.jpg is the official first pack preview retained as visual evidence.

All nine unmodified source files and runtime mappings:

- Building1_Large.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building1-large.glb
- Building1_Small.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building1-small.glb
- Building2_Large.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building2-large.glb
- Building2_Small.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building2-small.glb
- Building3_Big.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building3-big.glb
- Building3_Small.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building3-small.glb
- Building4.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/building4.glb
- House1.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/house1.glb
- House2.fbx -> assets/models/quaternius_buildings_pack/house2.glb

All files remain covered by Quaternius's CC0 dedication and are not relicensed
by the repository's MIT license.
